migration_policy: The initial records are empty because this change adds no production Lean declaration. Changed production modules require current content-bound independent review. Unchanged historical modules retain legacy publication debt; no source assimilation is inferred.

records.source_statement: Author-derived generic mathematical contract in docs/effect-stability/lesson.md; scope limited to effect probabilities and aligned circuit perturbation.
records.source_anchor: Version 1, normalized effect probability and aligned circuit specialization

obligation_map.source_obligation: The named literal definition or its displayed generic analytic/circuit statement in the lesson; internal producers are dependencies.

assumption_deltas.source: Finite complex Euclidean matrices, normalized state, actual unitary matrices and 0≤P≤I; auxiliary contraction leaf separately has its literal contraction premise. Aligned circuit specialization assumes the real alignment certificate and δ≥0.
assumption_deltas.formal: The exact scoped Matrix order/L2 operator context and displayed binders in the whole module. Effect norm, output norm and circuit perturbation are derived inside consumers.
assumption_deltas.explanation: No substituted oracle, algorithm, noise or resource premise; no proposed source repair. Exact-real ideal semantics only.

assumption_deltas.source: The motivating effect result is in a finite-dimensional complex Euclidean matrix setting. The auxiliary source proof uses only a normalized pair and a contraction.
assumption_deltas.formal: quadratic_difference_le is stated for any complex inner-product space E, with its own explicit contraction and two unit-norm premises; no positivity, self-adjointness, finite dimension or completeness is required.
assumption_deltas.explanation: This reusable auxiliary strengthens the domain while retaining the literal argument. The public matrix-effect consumers remain in the finite Euclidean source setting and derive the auxiliary premises internally. No ingredient is promoted to an extra source-facing premise.

graph_contribution.views: Lean: actual new canonical definitions/proofs; Source: authored formula proof; Spine: contraction/unitarity/quadratic split; Overview/Semantics catalog updated. Atlas/frontier/functor unchanged with reason: no new research route, rate or categorical claim.
graph_contribution.preserved_contract: Finite-dimensional exact-real normalized effect semantics; existing literal primitive circuit semantics and alignment preserved.
graph_contribution.remaining_boundary: No physical loading, noise process, estimator, synthesis or complexity theorem.

records.residual_boundary: Generic ideal analytic/circuit certificates only. No research route completion, resource optimality or runtime theorem.
